other shareholders (41%) | chairman = Steef Klop | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Anthony Correia (footballer, born 1982)|Anthony Correia]] | league = {{Dutch football updater|Utrecht}} | season = {{Dutch football updater|Utrecht2}} | position = {{Dutch football updater|Utrecht3}} | current = 2026–27 FC Utrecht season | pattern_la1 = _utrecht2627h | pattern_b1 = _utrecht2627h | pattern_ra1 = _utrecht2627h | pattern_sh1 =_utrecht2627h | pattern_so1 = _toponwhitel | leftarm1 = ed1a2f | body1 = ed1a2f | rightarm1 = ed1a2f | shorts1 = ed1a2f | socks1 = ed1a2f | pattern_la2 = _utrecht2627a | pattern_b2 = _utrecht2627a | pattern_ra2 = _utrecht2627a | pattern_sh2 = _utrecht2627a | pattern_so2 = _utrecht2627al | leftarm2 = 313C2C | body2 = 313C2C | rightarm2 = 313C2C | shorts2 = 313C2C | socks2 = 313C2C | pattern_la3 = _utrecht2627t | pattern_b3 = _utrecht2627t | pattern_ra3 = _utrecht2627t | pattern_sh3 =_utrecht2627t | pattern_so3 = _utrecht2627tl | leftarm3 = 008bd5 | body3 = 008bd5 | rightarm3 = 008bd5 | shorts3 = 008bd5 | socks3 = 008bd5 | website = {{official URL}} }} '''Football Club Utrecht''' ({{IPA|nl|ɛfˈseː ˈytrɛxt}}) is a Dutch professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Utrecht]].{{Cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/teams/netherlands/stichting-fc-utrecht/1523/|title=Netherlands - FC Utrecht - Results, fixtures, squad, statistics, photos, videos and news - Soccerway|website=int.soccerway.com|access-date=2020-03-27|archive-date=23 February 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200223234720/https://int.soccerway.com/teams/netherlands/stichting-fc-utrecht/1523/|url-status=live}} The club competes in the [[Eredivisie]], the top tier of [[Dutch football league system|Dutch football]], and plays its home matches at the [[Stadion Galgenwaard]]. The club was formed in 1970 as a merger between local clubs [[VV DOS]], [[USV Elinkwijk]] and Velox. Since then, the club has won three national [[KNVB Cup|cup tournaments]]: in [[1984–85 KNVB Cup|1985]], [[2002–03 KNVB Cup|2003]] and [[2003–04 KNVB Cup|2004]], also winning the [[Johan Cruyff Shield]] in [[2004 Johan Cruyff Shield|2004]] as the first club outside the traditional Dutch [[Big Three (Netherlands)|Big Three]]. Utrecht is also the only club outside the Big Three which has never suffered relegation from the top-flight Eredivisie. Utrecht have competed in 15 European campaigns, reaching the group stages of the [[2004–05 UEFA Cup]] and the [[2010–11 UEFA Europa League]], their best European results."}}
